History of Present Illness:
67-year-old man. Two days of dull lower abdominal discomfort and poor appetite, becoming localized to the right side. No vomiting and no measured fever.

Physical Examination:
Right lower-quadrant tenderness with mild guarding; abdomen otherwise soft. Temperature 37.1 C; heart rate 100/min; BP 128/78 mmHg; respiratory rate 22/min; SpO2 97% on room air.

Laboratory Tests:
WBC: 14.0 10^9/L (reference 4.0-11.0)
Hemoglobin: 13.9 g/dL (reference 12.0-17.5)
Platelets: 234 10^9/L (reference 150-400)
Sodium: 138 mmol/L (reference 135-145)
Potassium: 4.1 mmol/L (reference 3.5-5.0)
Creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (reference 0.6-1.3)
CRP: 63 mg/L (reference <5)
Lipase: 34 U/L (reference 13-60)
ALT: 30 U/L (reference 7-45)
AST: 27 U/L (reference 10-40)
Alkaline phosphatase: 89 U/L (reference 40-130)
Total bilirubin: 0.7 mg/dL (reference 0.2-1.2)

Imaging Findings:
CT abdomen/pelvis: 12 mm appendix with thickened enhancing wall and adjacent inflammatory stranding. No bowel obstruction or abscess.
